crossRefs.note: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
Folly is bound up in the heart of a child: the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

translations.web: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
translations.bsb: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest; he will bring delight to your soul.
translations.kjv: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
translations.asv: Correct thy son, and he will give thee rest; Yea, he will give delight unto thy soul.
